headline: Last EICMA trade day at Rho and last SMAU day at MiCo
taxi: Rho Fiera at 08:30 and 18:30; CityLife at SMAU close.
linate: Very busy: EICMA trade visitors, plus arrivals for Thursday's EICMA public opening and SIRM congress.

headline: EICMA public days open, SIRM radiology congress starts and AC Milan – Ferencváros at 18:45
taxi: Rho Fiera all day; San Siro arrivals 17:00–18:45 and exits 20:45–21:30; CityLife at congress close.
linate: Very busy: radiology delegates, EICMA visitors and Hungarian away fans.

headline: EICMA public day and SIRM congress on a Friday; easyJet cabin crew strike
taxi: Rho Fiera all day, heaviest at 18:30 closing; CityLife at congress close; centre Friday evening, more if it rains.
linate: Busy: SIRM delegates and EICMA visitors; easyJet cancellations possible all day (07:00–10:00 and 18:00–21:00 flights protected).

headline: EICMA Saturday at Rho (biggest crowd), SIRM congress and Nayt at Assago
taxi: Rho Fiera all day, peak at 18:30 closing; Assago exits around 23:30; centre Saturday night, more if it rains.
linate: Busy: weekend EICMA visitors; SIRM delegates starting to leave.

headline: Last EICMA and SIRM day plus Inter – Como at 18:00
taxi: Rho Fiera at 18:30 closing; San Siro arrivals 16:30–18:00 and exits 20:00–21:00.
linate: Busy evening departures as EICMA and SIRM visitors fly home.

headline: Italo rail strike 09:01–16:59 and Pitbull at Unipol Dome Santa Giulia
taxi: Centrale and Garibaldi stations as Italo passengers switch; Santa Giulia exits around 23:00.
linate: Some extra demand from travellers dropping Italo trains for flights.

headline: Quiet day: no big fair, match or arena show
taxi: Normal weekday demand; theatre exits in the centre (Arcimboldi, Teatro Lirico) around 23:00.

headline: Architect@Work and Forum Retail open, Tokio Hotel at Assago
taxi: Assago exits around 23:00; business districts at show closing.
linate: Some extra business arrivals for the trade shows.
